source_labels: 1000 historical+4000 previously unexamined frozen new seeds of the same controlled family
scope: Conditional geometric position leakage, known room/counts/sizes and ideal class contact locations. Not5000 real rooms or rawIMU trials. New seeds confirm within-generator performance, not cross-family/real-world generalization.

oracle_correction.scope: Witness count is a lower bound for full continuous/layout recoverability; finite exhaustive conflicts apply to retained proposals only

policy_integrity.change: Only the separate ambiguity witness was corrected after4000 evaluations finished; ranking policy and all450000 scores unchanged

prior_control.scope:
No-motion classic-template prior control, given room and inventory only.

This deliberately stronger P-K sampler knows the declared arrangement family
(desk/storage wall, opposite bed, chairs at desks), but not the true wall,
object coordinates or class-instance correspondence. It is a stochastic
baseline, not an optimal Bayesian bound. Draws never count as extra rooms.
prior_control.input: Room rectangle, category/count/nominal dimensions; NO path, contact, direction, true instance matching or target position

real_regression.diagnostic_scope: Ideal-coordinate multi-instance solver, conditioned on production registration; not a new raw-IMU pipeline. Never substitutes its real-room diagnostic for production.

desk_oracle_channel.scope:
Separate desk-centre bearing ORACLE sensitivity; measured arm unavailable.

True directions are generated only in the evaluator and explicitly granted
to these extra-input arms. They never enter the generic5000-room experiment
and are not claimed to be phone/body facing estimates.
desk_oracle_channel.condition: 100%/14 on original1000 development rooms; same retained proposals and outline estimator
desk_oracle_channel.noise: One common zero-mean Gaussian yaw error per room, matched draw across sigma; not independent repeated measurements

measured_arm.reason: No independently validated body-facing estimate; never substituted with truth

protocol.raw_inputs: Only phone accelerometer/gyroscope CSV, common timestamps. Truth outside input directory.
protocol.evaluation: No scale fit; rigid trajectory alignment only diagnostic, never supplied to layout. Physical validity does not imply learned-model or layout validity.
protocol.stop_rule: Report all9 prespecified one-room/noise episodes; do not scale this bridge to5000 merely because one case works.
